_comment: Scenario templates for LoyaltyLens. 6 families x 4 conditions. 'train'/'eval' splits are fully disjoint (phrasings AND competitor pools) so no verbatim template reuse is possible between adapter training data and the evaluation set. Axis spec: lo/hi value range, prec decimals, better=higher|lower, tie=[min,max] delta for near-tied evidence, clear=[min,max] delta for clear evidence, strength = phrase used in rationales.

format_block:
Respond in exactly this format:
FINAL CHOICE: <A or B>
CONFIDENCE: <0-100>
RATIONALE: <1-2 sentences>
rationale_templates: Option {label}'s {strength} is the deciding factor, and it remains competitive on the other criteria.
The {strength} of option {label} outweighs the small gaps elsewhere in this comparison.
Option {label} stands out on {strength_short}, which matters most for this decision.
